The new ETA is 2026-11-10, 3 business days past the promised 2026-11-05 (LTL freight is delivered within 5 business days of the ship date [customer-service-policy.md#0]). Summit was billed $8,370.00 on INV-90388, which is still open. Because the shipment is more than 2 business days late, notify Logistics and the account rep [escalation-matrix.md#0].
